title: Portobello Heritage Trust website
text:
Portobello Oral History Archive
Created by jtm websites
Terms & Conditions
Isa Dean
Explore our digital archive below. Each chapter of Portobello’s history can be 
experienced in two ways: listen to the Audio Files, authentic recordings made in 
years gone by and restored for clarity, with nothing added or re-voiced; or watch 
our Video Essays, where those same genuine voices are illustrated with AI-assisted 
reconstructions of the people, places and eras described. The voices are real; the 
images are our reinterpretation of the period.
